_comment: Navigation of the edition by the objects readers work with (operator's rule 39 of 2026-11-14; four objects since the interface plan of 2026-11-17): one head item per object, and the representations of an object as a switch inside its view. One source for the static pages (build_site) and the interactive views (js/app.js). Paths are relative to the site root; the interactive views live under ansicht/. Start is the entry page (2026-11-18); Atlas and Regesten are static pages that mount their view; `app` is their address inside the views app of the repository, where no static page exists. The former object Orte forwards to the Atlas; the view Raum and the switch item Liste of Personen are gone since 2026-11-18 (Raum on the operator's decision of 2026-11-17; the person index stays as a page without JavaScript and is reached from the person pages).
